acceptanceCriteria: A receipt produced from finalize-recovery-plan can be completed with the archived Contract resourceContext and is accepted only for direct_merge_no_pr historical_low receipts bound to real Git parents.
The same receipt remains rejected for foreign repository/work item, branch/worktree/base mismatches, malformed or symlink inputs, and fabricated or non-ancestor merge identities.
finalize-recovery-plan includes a truthful resourceContext recommendation and actionable human-input boundary without writing repository state.
Existing shared-worktree and historical recovery behavior remains compatible and all targeted plus workspace tests pass.
goal: Make finalize-recovery-plan output actionable and allow object repositories to record truthful no-PR direct-merge history without PR fabrication or manual .ai edits.
intent: Accept a complete historical direct-merge receipt when the receipt preserves the archived Contract resourceContext, while keeping identity validation narrow and fail-closed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: historical direct-merge receipt preserves archived resource context
